**Dark Mode Is Here for Everyone**

Since May 12, dark mode has been available to 100% of our users. If you've been waiting for a gentler way to write late at night, open your settings and turn it on.

This feature came from you. During our beta, 38% of testers asked for dark mode, more than for any other request we heard. We took that seriously and spent the time to do it properly instead of just inverting the colors.

Readability came first. Text in dark mode has a 7:1 contrast ratio, which meets the WCAG AAA standard for normal text. Your notes stay sharp and easy to read whether you're skimming a grocery list or reviewing pages of meeting notes. Headings, links, highlights and code blocks were all re-tuned so nothing gets lost against the darker background.

You can choose dark mode, light mode, or let the app follow your device's system setting and switch automatically as the day goes on.

Thank you to everyone who tested early builds and sent feedback. Please keep it coming, because many of our best features start with your suggestions.
